tools.name: cart_add_item
tools.description: Add a product to the shopper's basket by product id (from search_products / get_product). The shopper still pays at checkout.

product_name.description: Product name, shown in the shopper's notification.

tools.name: cart_apply_promo
tools.description: Apply a promo code to the basket. The shop validates codes against the shopper's email, so provide the email the order will use.

tools.name: cart_clear
tools.description: Empty the shopper's basket.

tools.name: cart_get
tools.description: The shopper's current basket on this site: lines (product id, SKU, name, quantity, unit price), item count, subtotal, promo code and the cart/checkout URLs.

tools.name: cart_remove_item
tools.description: Remove a product from the basket by product id.

tools.name: cart_remove_promo
tools.description: Remove the applied promo code from the basket.

tools.name: cart_update_item
tools.description: Set the quantity of a basket line (product id).

tools.name: check_express_eligibility
tools.description: Whole-basket Website Express verdict for a set of product ids and quantities: every line must be eligible (no split shipments).

items.description: Basket lines as product ids with quantities.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

tools.name: check_shipping_availability
tools.description: Whether Camden Tools ships to a country, with any restriction message.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. GB, IE, DE, US.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 to 5 products by SKU: price ex/inc VAT, stock, brand, weight and the specification bullet points, so an agent can recommend between options.

items.description: Product SKU exactly as shown on the site.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

tools.name: create_basket_link
tools.description: Turn product ids and quantities into one link that fills the shopper's basket on camdentools.com. Opening the link makes sure the basket holds at least those quantities (opening it twice does not double them); the shopper reviews the basket and pays at checkout themselves. The result says which lines are out of stock: those cannot be bought, so offer an alternative before sharing the link. Use it to finish a shopping conversation. Ids come from search_products, list_products or get_product.

items.description: Basket lines as product ids with quantities.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

tools.name: estimate_delivery
tools.description: Delivery services, charges and transit times for a basket to a destination (country plus postcode/ZIP and city). This is an estimate using placeholder contact details; exact rates are confirmed at checkout.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. GB, IE, DE, US.

items.description: Basket lines as product ids with quantities.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Who Camden Tools is, how to contact them, VAT display rules, key page links, current announcements and a summary of each policy (delivery, returns, payment, FAQs). Call get_policy for the full text of a policy.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

tools.name: get_stock_level
tools.description: Live availability check for a SKU (is it available now and how many are in the London warehouse).

sku.description: Product SKU exactly as shown on the site.

tools.name: inspect_image_c2pa
tools.description: Fetch a single image (by CSS selector or URL) and return its fully decoded C2PA manifest store: every manifest's claim, assertions (e.g. c2pa.actions edit history, schema.org authorship), and the COSE signature details (algorithm and signing-certificate identity). Provide exactly one of `selector` or `url`. Note: the signature is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

selector.description: CSS selector for an element on the page.

url.description: Image URL (absolute, or relative to the current page) to fetch and inspect.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Brands sold by Camden Tools (DeWalt, Makita, Milwaukee, Bosch, Stanley …). Without a query returns the popular brands; with a query searches brand names.

sort.description: Sort order: price_low, price_high, name_asc, name_desc or newest. Omit for the default (most popular) order.

tools.name: list_bundles
tools.description: Curated product bundles (kits) with their items and prices.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Product categories with slugs and links. Use popular_only for the curated set shown on the site; otherwise the full list.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.description: The signed-in shopper's order history (most recent first). Needs the shopper's browser session with AI agent access, or an OAuth token with the orders:read scope.

tools.name: list_offers
tools.description: Current storefront promotions (percentage/fixed discounts and free gifts), optionally grouped by brand or category. Also points at the /offers page.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Browse a product collection: most popular, newest, on sale, Website Express eligible, or a category by slug (see list_categories). Supports paging, sorting and brand/price filters.

sort.description: Sort order: price_low, price_high, name_asc, name_desc or newest. Omit for the default (most popular) order.

min_price.description: Minimum price in the locale currency.

max_price.description: Maximum price in the locale currency.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

tools.name: lookup_uk_postcode
tools.description: Addresses for a UK postcode (rate limited upstream). Returns matching addresses or suggestions when the postcode is incomplete.

tools.name: newsletter_subscribe
tools.description: Start a Camden Tools newsletter sign-up (offers, new products and trade news) with the shopper's email address. The shopper then gives consent and submits the form themselves.

tools.name: page_get_context
tools.description: What the shopper is looking at right now: page type (product, category, search, cart, checkout…), the product on a product page (SKU, name, price), the search query, locale, VAT display mode, basket count and a basket handoff link for the current basket.

tools.name: page_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the shopper's browser within camdentools.com: a product (slug), category (slug), search results (query), the basket, checkout, or any site path.

tools.name: page_prefill_checkout_address
tools.description: On the checkout page, pre-fill the delivery contact and address form. The shopper reviews it and completes payment themselves; nothing is submitted.

tools.name: page_request_account_access
tools.description: Ask the shopper to allow AI agent access to their account (orders, profile). Opens a consent prompt in the page; returns whether it was granted. Required before get_my_profile / list_my_orders / get_my_order.

tools.name: page_select_variant
tools.description: On a product page, switch to the variant matching the given options (e.g. {"Colour": "Red", "Size": "M"}) or SKU by navigating to its page.

tools.name: page_set_vat_display
tools.description: Switch the site's price display between including and excluding VAT.

tools.name: scan_images_c2pa
tools.description: Scan every on the current page for C2PA Content Credentials (content provenance metadata) and return a per-image summary: whether a manifest is present, the claim generator (the tool that produced or edited the image), the title, and the signer name. Use this to find which images on a page carry provenance data. Note: provenance is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to fetch and scan (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: search_blog_posts
tools.description: Guides and articles from the Camden Tools blog (how-tos, buying guides, brand news).

query.description: Search text; omit for the latest posts.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Full-text search of the Camden Tools catalogue (hand tools, power tools, accessories, safety equipment). Returns compact products with prices ex/inc VAT, stock and a link. Use page/per_page to paginate and brand/min_price/max_price to narrow down.

query.description: What the shopper is looking for, e.g. 'cordless combi drill 18v'.

express.description: Only products eligible for Website Express same-day dispatch (UK).

sort.description: Sort order: price_low, price_high, name_asc, name_desc or newest. Omit for the default (most popular) order.

min_price.description: Minimum price in the locale currency.

max_price.description: Maximum price in the locale currency.

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

tools.name: track_guest_order
tools.description: Order status, tracking number/URL, shipping method and line items for any order, given the order number and the delivery postcode (no sign-in needed).

order_number.description: Order number from the confirmation email.

postcode.description: Delivery postcode / ZIP on the order.

tools.description: Save a product to the shopper's wishlist by product id.

tools.name: wishlist_remove
tools.description: Remove a product from the shopper's wishlist by product id.
